_metadata.purpose: ATDR v0.9 layered detection contribution expectations for controlled synthetic/replay scenarios.
_metadata.scope: Lab-scale defensive validation only; not production certification.
_metadata.response_safety: No automatic response actions may be created by validation runs.

normal_allowed_traffic.notes: Routine allowed traffic should avoid noisy high/critical alerts.

normal_web_dns_quic_traffic.notes: Common web, DNS, and QUIC traffic should remain quiet.

normal_high_volume_but_allowed_traffic.notes: Approved high-volume traffic should not be treated as exfiltration by default.

normal_repeated_same_service_traffic.notes: Repeated same-service access should not look like scanning.

mixed_small_subnet_validation.notes: Rules should catch known mixed patterns; hybrid should preserve those detections and add layered context.

port_scan_like_traffic.notes: Rules should catch repeated unique destination-port behavior; anomaly may add supporting signal.

brute_force_like_traffic.notes: Rules should catch repeated denied service/authentication attempts.

malware_c2_like_beaconing.notes: Rules should catch repeated outbound beacon-like behavior; hybrid should show combined risk.

data_exfiltration_suspicion.notes: Rules should catch high outbound byte-volume suspicion; anomaly may support unusual volume.

ddos_or_connection_flood_like.notes: Rules should catch repeated connection-flood-like behavior.

repeated_dedup_traffic.notes: Rules and hybrid should deduplicate repeated evidence instead of creating endless duplicate alerts.

generic_syslog_mixed.notes: Generic syslog should preserve raw evidence and parser visibility without forcing threat alerts.

malformed_raw_fallback.notes: Malformed raw fallback should not crash and should not create automatic response.

policy_violation_suspicious_app.notes: Rules should catch risky app characteristics; hybrid should describe combined SOC triage evidence.
